messages.text: Which miner are you asking about? Most of ours pool mine by default, but I want to answer for the right one.

The listing spells it out as solo mining, pointed at your own node and address. It doesn't state pool support either way, so I don't want to guess on that one.

I've put it to JD on our hardware side. He picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and you'll get the answer by email, so no need to wait here.

What's the best email for that reply?
